entries.scope: The AI emergency pause, the runaway-loop kill switch, the eight-form rollback taxonomy, the §43.3.5 fifteen-row console authority matrix, and the new /super-admin/ai-incidents route carrying the SB-43-351 incident console and the SB-43-102 open-values panel.
entries.reviewer_identity: opus, dispatched as an independent subagent
entries.independence_evidence: Dispatched with the brief and the commit range only, no access to the implementer's report or transcript; authorized under approval-ledger.json APP-002. The reviewer measured its own suite counts (169 files / 5681 tests, higher than the controller's 168 / 5673 because a concurrent agent was adding tests in a disjoint path list) and opened 102 unique L-citations itself.
entries.findings_summary: 2 Critical, 7 Important, 8 Moderate, 7 Minor. Critical: (C1) AC-42-303 cited to a blank line L89412 and paraphrased into a rule it does not state, inside the shared mode-to-failure join another task was importing at the time — controller independently confirmed AC-42-303 occurs on exactly one line, L89402, and that the criterion distinguishes pause modes from OUTAGE modes ('a paused platform and an unreachable one'), not the two pause scopes from each other; (C2) AiFailureAuthorityPanel.tsx:209 prints 'No authority settled' on the provider-or-model-failover row whose own reason on the same card reads 'the authority is settled and the governing policy is an open decision' — defect shape 6, a state fold applied to one branch. Important: a module claiming to hold no population figure while holding and RENDERING one; two count gates that cannot fail on the defect they name (one exempting the literal string, one stripping every quoted literal before scanning — 0 offenders with the strip, 12 without); a shippability sweep omitting the one token that IS re-derived at two call sites; a 23-locator citation gate asserting only that the line is non-blank; a hard-coded 'Three' inside the sentence claiming no number is written; and a screen stating in the present tense that refusals are written to an audit trail that does not exist.
entries.verdict_text: CHANGES REQUIRED — 8 blocking (C1, C2, I3, I4/I5, I6, I7, I8, I9), Moderates M10-M17 to sweep in the same pass, Minors m18-m24 riding along.
entries.extra_note: WHAT THE REVIEW CONFIRMED: Every other claim held on checking: all 102 citations resolve except L89412; rollback is eight forms parsed from transcribed bytes with all four L87816 clauses verbatim and no control labelled 'rollback'; no third pause scope operable and DEC-AIPAUSE-001 measured at exactly five source lines, absent from the §41.9 register; shippability derived with no literal 5, 3 or 15; zero timer or auto-resume primitives tree-wide; all four acts refused for all four roster agents through one path; no invented value anywhere; no tenant operational content on the console for any of four roles; exactly one PROV class per element, all PROV-4; no manufacturing-severity component imported; src/disclosure/decisions.ts untouched with four decisions disclosed locally; reachability proved in both directions; and the PAUSE_STATES length pin removed rather than renumbered and replaced with a typed literal list. || REVIEWER CAVEAT: The reviewer could not observe the implementer's claim that each of eighteen gates was watched red and restored, and found that five of them cannot fail on the defect their own documentation names — which suggests the red-then-restore was performed against a different mutation. That is the finding behind I4, I5, I6, I7 and M11. || FIX ROUND: Dispatched as a single fix agent over an exclusive path list, one finding at a time, test-first, with before-and-after conviction evidence required for every gate whose defect IS that it cannot fail.
